_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. NOMA based integration of DAS and Coherent Comms. 60 GBaud 16-QAM + 10m PZT sensing over 10km fiber.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 1: NOMA concept and constellation. Figure 2: Setup (AWG, 10km FUT, PZT, Coherent RX). Figure 3: Results (Spectrum, BER, Sensitivity).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Fiber ISAC. Modulation: NOMA (Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access) to overlay LFM sensing tone on 16-QAM comms. Sensing: DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensing) using Rayleigh backscatter.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 60 GBaud 16-QAM (~240 Gbps, or 480 Gbps inclusive of pol-mux? Text says 60 Gbaud 16-QAM). BER near baseline with >10dB power ratio. Sensing: 10m resolution (PZT detection). Sensitivity high due to pulse compression.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Novel application of NOMA for ISAC. LFM tone acts as sensing signal AND pilot for FOE/CPR in comms. Solves resource allocation (orthogonal) problem by using power domain.

bibliographic.title: Integration of Distributed Sensing into Optical Coherent Networks through Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access
bibliographic.authors: Jingchuan Wang, Liwang Lu, Junwei Zhang, Alan Pak Tao Lau, Chao Lu
bibliographic.venue: ACP/IPOC 2024 (Implied by footer '979-8-3503-6765-2/24/$31.00 ©2024 IEEE' - likely conference paper, title suggests journal style but short. Let's assume Conference)

application.scenario_description: Metro/Access network with integrated DAS for vibration sensing using NOMA.

key_contribution.key_contribution: NOMA-based integration of DAS and coherent communication.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Resource scarcity in orthogonal multiplexing (TDM/FDM) for sensing.

receiver.notes: Coherent receiver with SIC (Successive Interference Cancellation) for Comms. DAS receiver for Sensing.

channel_fibre.notes: 10 km FUT. 10m PZT for vibration test.

comm_metrics.notes: 60 GBaud * 4 bits/sym = 240 Gbps. BER analysis shows negligible penalty at >10dB power ratio.

sensing_metrics.notes: 10m resolution (based on LFM BW). Detects 100Hz vibration.
